info.title: traini.ac API
info.description: Live UK rail data from Network Rail's and National Rail's open feeds. Every answer is an Ok or an ErrorResponse, told apart by `type` and by the HTTP status. Every key is always present: null means a value does not exist, and states (cancelled, no information yet, withheld) are union members with a `type`.

404.description: A station, train or endpoint we could not find.

429.description: Over the per-client allowance. Retry-After says when to try again.

500.description: The query and the model disagree: ours to fix.

503.description: The database is busy or unavailable. Retry-After when busy.

PlaceLocation.description: A railway location with no public station code: a junction, siding or depot.

Place.description: Somewhere a train is or calls.

name.description: e.g. Great Western Railway. null when we have no name for the code.

ServiceClass.description: What kind of service it is, from the timetable. unknown: no schedule matched.

EstimateActual.description: It has happened, at this time.

source.description: darwin: National Rail's forecast. live_report: the last TRUST report's lateness carried forward.

EstimateDelayedNoEstimate.description: Known to be late, by an amount nobody can say yet.

EstimateNoInformation.description: Nothing live or forecast is known yet. Not the same as on time.

EstimateCancelled.description: The service is cancelled, so this will not happen.

Estimate.description: What is known about when something happens.

Time.description: A timetabled time and what is known about it.

delay_minutes.description: Minutes after scheduled (negative is early) when the estimate has a time; null when it has none.

number.description: A platform is a string: 4A, 10, B.

source.description: actual: where TRUST reported it. forecast: Darwin's. timetable: planned only, often wrong at large stations.

PlatformWithheld.description: Darwin asks that the platform not be shown yet.

id.description: TRUST train id, e.g. 671L50MK02. null until TRUST activates the train.

uid.description: Timetable (CIF) uid, e.g. GW001. null where the answer does not identify the schedule.

headcode.description: e.g. 1L50. Headcodes repeat across the country.

ResolutionGroup.description: A name for several stations, all of which were searched.

StationArgument.description: A station argument and what it was understood to mean.

CallingPoint.description: A stop after this station. The time is the arrival where the stop has a public arrival, else the departure.

FormationChange.description: The train divides, or joins another portion, later on.

FormedFrom.description: The inbound train that physically becomes this one. If it is late, this usually is too.

expected_arrival.description: When the inbound is expected here. null when there is no time for it.

destination_arrival.description: Booked arrival at its destination. null when the timetable has none.

coaches.description: Coaches in the formation here, from Darwin. null when Darwin has not said.

delay_reason.description: Darwin's reason for lateness. null when it has given none.

advertised.description: false when Darwin asks that this call not be shown on boards.

from_time.description: HH:MM, UK local. null when not given.

to_time.description: HH:MM, UK local. null when not given.

Leg.description: One train, boarded at from and left at to. from is null only when the journey was asked from a group of stations and the itinerary does not say which one it leaves from.

coaches.description: Coaches, where Darwin says. null otherwise.

minutes.description: Timetabled minutes between arriving and leaving.

outlook.description: at_risk: live running leaves less than the minimum interchange. unknown: one side is late with no estimate.

connections.description: connections[i] is the change from legs[i] to legs[i + 1].

from_time.description: HH:MM, UK local. null when not given.

to_time.description: HH:MM, UK local. null when not given.

Report.description: A TRUST movement report. location is null when the report's location is not in our location data.

event.description: TRUST reports a pass as a departure.

off_route.description: Reported somewhere its schedule does not go.

ProgressNotStarted.description: In today's timetable, with no movement reports yet.

activated.description: TRUST has activated it: it is expected to run.

TrainRun.description: One run of a train. origin and destination are null when no schedule matched the run.

planned.description: A planned reduction (engineering work and the like) rather than something going wrong.

CancelledBeforeDeparture.description: Cancelled at its origin, before it started (TRUST: AT ORIGIN).

CancelledPartWay.description: Started, and was cancelled from here on (TRUST: EN ROUTE).

CancelledNotNeeded.description: A schedule that only runs when called upon, and was not needed (TRUST: ON CALL).

CancelledOffBookedPath.description: Cancelled while running somewhere its schedule does not go (TRUST: OUT OF PLAN).

CancellationKind.description: Where in its run the train was cancelled, and where that was.

Cancellation.description: origin, destination, train.uid and train.operator are null when TRUST cancelled a train before activating it, so its schedule is unknown; service_class is then unknown.

keyed_at.description: When it was entered into TRUST. Can be hours before, for a cancellation planned ahead.

Movement.description: A movement TRUST reported at the station.

StationMatchLocation.description: Somewhere that is not a public station.

crs.description: Some depots and sidings carry an operational code.

StationSearch.description: resolves_to is the group, alias or landmark the query itself names, or null.

near_misses.description: true when nothing matched as written and these are the closest names.

FreshnessSilent.description: Nothing stored in the window looked at.

FreshnessUnknown.description: The database could not be asked.

TrainsRunningUnknown.description: The live map did not answer.

health.description: ok only when every feed is fresh.

terms.description: Who may use the API: personal, non-commercial projects only, and a link to the full terms.

did_you_mean.description: Near misses, never acted on for you. Empty when nothing came close.
